explainability.explanation: For December 2020, the model predicts 30.92 m against an average of 24.44 m. The largest contributions are: level one month ago (+4.81 m); average level over the previous 6 months (+0.65 m); recent variability (6-month std) (+0.57 m).

recommendations.action: Set a water-conservation target and track progress against the 10–30% reduction scenarios.
recommendations.evidence: Under the assumed extraction response, a 20% cut lowers the 12-month level by about 0.07 m.
